player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I did not track the set of visited rooms to detect loops or unvisited neighbors, leading me to create invalid self-loops (e.g., "Balcony" to "Balcony") and leaving the "Guest room" edge incomplete ("?"). Next time, I will maintain an internal list of visited nodes and edges. Before moving, I will check if the current direction leads to an already visited node; if so, I will try a different available direction. I will only mark an edge as complete once I have confirmed the destination room name from the Game Master's response. I will continue exploring until all reachable nodes are visited and no new directions lead to unvisited rooms, then output DONE.
